PluginEntry.Name: VM Sentinel
PluginEntry.Author: BGriffin63
PluginEntry.Overview:
VM Sentinel monitors your Unraid virtual machines and tells you when something changes. It watches VM lifecycle events (start, stop, shutdown, crash, pause, resume, reboot) through a namespaced libvirt hook that coexists safely with other plugins, records a local event history, and sends alerts through Unraid's native notification system and/or a Discord webhook (no bot required).
Optional agentless health checks (ICMP ping, TCP port, QEMU guest agent) tell you when a VM is running but not actually responding — with anti-spam thresholds so you are notified only on confirmed failure and recovery.
VM Sentinel is fail-open by design: a problem inside the plugin can never stop a VM from starting, stopping, or changing state. It never modifies VM XML, never replaces shared QEMU hooks, opens no inbound ports, and collects no telemetry.
VM Sentinel is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Lime Technology, Inc.
PluginEntry.Changes: See the CHANGELOG in the repository.
PluginEntry.Privacy: VM Sentinel collects no telemetry and contacts no developer-controlled servers. The only outbound network traffic is a Discord webhook YOU configure, and calls to Unraid's local notification agent. The Discord webhook URL is stored locally with restricted permissions and is redacted in all logs, diagnostics, and exports.
